register.title: Create your account
register.consent: I consent to my data (email, drafts, search history, chat history) being processed to provide this platform's features, scoped to my university and never shared across institutions.

auth.overviewTitle: Research, integrity, and writing support -- in one place.
auth.overviewDescription: Find credible sources, check your AI-use policy, and get writing feedback in English or Bahasa Malaysia -- built for low-data mobile connections.

errors.google_failed: Google sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
errors.google_no_account: No account found for that Google email. Register first, then Google sign-in will work.

dashboard.subtitle: Your academic workspace
dashboard.goal: Goal: find 5 credible sources, learn how to cite them, and check your AI-use rules in under 20 minutes.

research.title: Research Discovery
research.description: Type a topic. We'll search open-access databases and summarise the literature for you.
research.placeholder: e.g. impact of social media on academic performance
research.emptyTitle: Your evidence map will appear here
research.empty: Search a topic to see themes, findings, gaps and the sources behind the summary.
research.noAbstracts: We found sources but couldn't retrieve enough abstract text to summarise them. See the source list below.

integrity.empty: Every answer shows the policy clause behind it.
integrity.title: Academic Integrity Advisor
integrity.description: Ask about AI-use rules, plagiarism, citation methods, or misconduct consequences -- answered from your university's actual policy.
integrity.placeholder: Type your question in English or Bahasa Malaysia...
integrity.disclaimer: Answers are grounded in your university's uploaded policy documents. If unsure, always confirm with your faculty.
integrity.confirmDelete: Delete this conversation? This can't be undone.

writing.title: Writing Support Agent
writing.description: Paste a paragraph or abstract for structured feedback. We will not rewrite it for you -- your work stays your own.
writing.placeholder: Paste your draft paragraph or abstract here...
writing.integrityNoteBody: We never rewrite your text and do not retain your draft after this session.
writing.empty: See exactly where your reasoning, evidence and sentence flow can become stronger.

sources.empty: Annotations and credibility tags help you decide which sources are strong enough to cite.
sources.title: Source Organiser
sources.description: Paste URLs or paper titles, one per line. We'll format references, annotate them, and check credibility.

admin.title: Policy Knowledge Base
admin.description: Upload your university's AI-use policy, MQA guidelines, and NAGI framework documents.
admin.logoDescription: Shown on the dashboard for your policy admins and students. PNG, JPEG, SVG, or WebP, up to 2MB.
admin.logoResizeHint: Drag the handle to resize how the logo appears on the dashboard.

superAdmin.title: University Tenants
superAdmin.description: Onboard a new university onto the platform with its own isolated data and an initial policy admin account.
superAdmin.empty: Onboard the first university to get started.
superAdmin.created: University onboarded. Share the admin email/password with their policy admin.
